title: Field extension in dimension zero
statement:
Let $k\subset k'$ be algebraically closed fields, let $C$ be a separated
finite-type $k$-scheme of dimension at most zero, and let $F$ be a torsion
etale sheaf on $C$, so that $(C,F)$ is a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. The pullback map
$\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,F):H^q(C_{\Et},F)\to H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F)$ along the projection $\pi:C_{k'}=C\times_kk'\to C$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback], i.e. the map $\pi^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], is an isomorphism for every $q\geq0$.

proof.text: *The base change.* Write $C'=C_{k'}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$, $\pi:C'\to C$ the projection and $F'=\pi^{-1}F$, an abelian sheaf on $C'_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback]. Since $C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated and of finite type, so is its base change $C'\to\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change]. By [lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-base-change-points] ($k$ algebraically closed): $|C|$ is finite, every $c\in|C|$ has $\kappa(c)=k$, $\dim C'\le0$, and $\pi$ induces a bijection $|C'|\to|C|$. So $C'$ is a separated finite-type scheme of dimension $\le0$ over the algebraically closed field $k'$, and both $(C,F)$ over $k$ and $(C',F')$ over $k'$ satisfy the hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-cohomology] and [lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-sections-stalks] (which need no torsion hypothesis).

source.place: ## Proof (its base change is $\coprod_c\operatorname{Spec}k'$); literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex proof of Lemma Tag 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open): a zero-dimensional $Z$ is a finite set of $k$-rational points

proof.text: *Degrees $q>0$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-cohomology] applied to $(C,F)$ over $k$ and to $(C',F')$ over $k'$ (step 1), $H^q(C_{\Et},F)=0$ and $H^q(C'_{\Et},F')=0$ for $q>0$. A homomorphism between zero groups is an isomorphism, so $\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,F)$ is an isomorphism for $q>0$.

source.place: ## Proof, first sentence; literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex proof of Lemma Tag 0GJA ('we conclude that $H^q_\etale(Z,i^*\mathcal F)=0$ for $q>0$') and proof of Lemma Tag 0A5B, first paragraph

proof.text: *Degree $0$ is the unit on global sections.* $\rho^0_{k'/k}(C,F)$ is the pullback map $\pi^*:H^0(C_{\Et},F)\to H^0(C'_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] for $u=\pi$, $G=F$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback]. By [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero] (1) the maps $\epsilon_{C,F}:F(C)\to H^0(C_{\Et},F)$ and $\epsilon_{C',F'}:F'(C')\to H^0(C'_{\Et},F')$ are isomorphisms, and by its clause (2) $\pi^*\circ\epsilon_{C,F}=\epsilon_{C',F'}\circ\eta_{\pi,F}(C)$, where $\eta_{\pi,F}(C):F(C)\to(\pi_*\pi^{-1}F)(C)=F'(C')$ is the unit of $\pi^{-1}\dashv\pi_*$ on global sections [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Hence $\rho^0_{k'/k}(C,F)=\epsilon_{C',F'}\circ\eta_{\pi,F}(C)\circ\epsilon_{C,F}^{-1}$, and $\rho^0$ is an isomorphism if and only if $\eta_{\pi,F}(C)$ is bijective.

source.place: ## Proof ('its map on sections is the identity'); literature/stacks-project/cohomology.tex Section Tag 01F7, equation Tag 01FA

proof.text:
*The unit on global sections is bijective.* For each $c'\in|C'|$ choose a geometric point $\bar c':\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_{c'}\to C'$ over $c'$, and put $\bar c=\pi\circ\bar c'$, a geometric point of $C$ over $c=\pi(c')$. Since $c'\mapsto\pi(c')$ is a bijection $\sigma:|C'|\to|C|$ (step 1), this chooses exactly one geometric point over each point of $C$. Consider
$$\gamma_{C,F}:F(C)\to\prod_{c\in|C|}F_{\bar c},\qquad \gamma_{C',F'}:F'(C')\to\prod_{c'\in|C'|}F'_{\bar c'},$$
the germ maps of [lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-sections-stalks], applied over $k$ to $(C,F)$ with the points $\bar c=\pi\circ\bar c'$ and over $k'$ to $(C',F')$ with the points $\bar c'$; both are isomorphisms. Let $\kappa:\prod_{c'}F'_{\bar c'}\to\prod_{c}F_{\bar c}$ send $(x_{c'})_{c'}$ to the family whose $\sigma(c')$-component is $c_{\pi,\bar c',F}(x_{c'})$, with $c_{\pi,\bar c',F}:(\pi^{-1}F)_{\bar c'}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{\pi\circ\bar c'}$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ]; $\kappa$ is an isomorphism, being a product of isomorphisms reindexed along the bijection $\sigma$. For $a\in F(C)$, the $c'$-component of $\gamma_{C',F'}(\eta_{\pi,F}(C)(a))$ is the germ $(\eta_{\pi,F}(C)(a))_{\bar c'}$, and by the germ compatibility of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] (case $U=C$) $c_{\pi,\bar c',F}\bigl((\eta_{\pi,F}(C)(a))_{\bar c'}\bigr)=a_{\pi\circ\bar c'}=a_{\bar c}$, the $\sigma(c')$-component of $\gamma_{C,F}(a)$. Thus $\kappa\circ\gamma_{C',F'}\circ\eta_{\pi,F}(C)=\gamma_{C,F}$, so $\eta_{\pi,F}(C)=\gamma_{C',F'}^{-1}\circ\kappa^{-1}\circ\gamma_{C,F}$ is bijective. By step 3, $\rho^0_{k'/k}(C,F)$ is an isomorphism; with step 2, $\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,F)$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$. (If $C=\emptyset$ all groups are $0$ and the claim is trivial; the argument above covers it with empty products.)

split_report.summary: Replaced the imported one-paragraph proof by four steps with a direct argument through lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-cohomology (which already handles non-reduced C), not through the universal-homeomorphism reduction to C_red: thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance and def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions are no longer used (the latter was cited only for the name of rho). Step 1: C_{k'} separated finite type over k' (Mathlib leaf lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change) of dim <= 0 with pi bijective on points (new node lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-base-change-points). Step 2: q>0 by lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-cohomology on both sides. Step 3: rho^0 equals the unit eta_pi(C) on global sections under H^0 = Gamma (new node lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero; lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial has no degree-0 clause). Step 4: eta_pi(C) is bijective by comparing germ maps F(C) -> prod F_{bar c} (new node lem-weil-pbc-zero-dimensional-sections-stalks, the explicit map behind the 'canonical' H^0 identification of the cohomology lemma) with the stalk isomorphism (pi^{-1}F)_{bar c'} = F_{pi bar c'} compatible with germs of pulled-back sections (new node lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ; the closed node lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar gives the isomorphism but not the germ compatibility). Statement kept; stmt_deps now name def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback and def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback (rho is defined there, not in def-weil-pbc-curve-setting). The torsion hypothesis is not used. Searches of three kinds recorded; no Mathlib leaf.
